title: No Cleaning Fees! Close to Everything!
description:
Cole House Nash is locally owned by a non investor, who is a Super host on AirBnB/Premier Partner on VRBO 1/4 Mile to Geodis Park, 1 exit to Downtown/Honky Tonks and 2 Miles to nearly everything. Our home is a perfect match for your stay in Nashville. 

Charming 1940s Nashville bungalow located in Wedgewood-Houston where you can explore the city & live like a local. Enjoy the comforts of our fully furnished home, huge fenced in private backyard and great proximity to all Nashville has to offer.

The space
Traveling can be exhausting! We proudly include the following complimentary items to provide the comforts of home and help you ease into your stay.

Oatmeal Packets/Cream of Wheat Packets
Coffee/tea/hot cocoa bar
Bottled waters

Enjoyable walk or quick Lyft/Uber to many of Nashville's top rated colleges, coffee spots, restaurants, pubs, bars:, entertainment and airport.
